paragraphs: Semantropy is a desktop-only Obsidian plugin for creative writing in Japanese. It makes unexpected variations of a Markdown note in a separate view, without changing the source note. The name combines semantic and entropy.
The analyzer is Lindera WebAssembly with an embedded compact IPADIC dictionary. It works locally and offline after installation. No dictionary directory or runtime download is required.
features: Transform Japanese prose. Open the current note. Opening reads the note and prepares its vocabulary but does not shuffle anything: the body shows Generate until you press it (Generate text in the Shuffle tab's own bar…

Choose the target. The Shuffle tab has its own bar under the tab row: Choose target note, the target's name, and Reshuffle text (named Generate text until the first generation), Refresh target, Copy selection and…

Two tabs. The area below the toolbar has two tabs, Shuffle and Recompose. They are there even when no note is open; then Shuffle only tells you to open one (the Choose target note button picks one without opening it),…

Choose vocabulary. Use the current note or explicitly selected notes as Vocabulary Sources. Once a vocabulary is applied, the status line names its notes, for example Vocabulary: Current Note “Cherry.md” · Draw mode:…

Group words in a Vocabulary Source. Text written like {{猫又}} in a Vocabulary Source is one noun. Extra term delimiters in the settings adds up to four more pairs such as 【…】; {{…}} is always on. The Target's display is…
